summary: Miqyas read 120 stories across Dawn News, Geo News, and Business Recorder this week. Taken as a whole, coverage leaned cautious rather than either encouraging or alarming: most stories across all three readings landed on neutral, 62% of economic readings, 63% of political readings, and 47% of social readings, the AI's way of saying a story didn't clearly signal improvement or harm either way.

Social readings were the exception. Two in five stories (40%) read as socially negative this week, well above the negative share on the economic (29%) or political (24%) readings. That gap traces to a real cluster of security and safety stories: a police checkpost attack in KP's Hangu that left nine officers dead, the bodies of six abducted labourers recovered in Balochistan's Nasirabad, and a fatal coal mine explosion in Quetta whose search and rescue operation ran for several days.

On the political reading, the week's dominant storyline was the AJK election dispute. PML-N's early lead in Mirpur division drew repeated allegations of rigging from PPP figures, including a warning from PPP chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari that a federal government 'countdown' would begin if the results stood, claims this reporting could not independently verify and that PML-N and the election commission disputed in turn. Miqyas's political-lean reading stayed balanced across nearly all of this coverage, only three stories this week leaned pro-government, and each at low or medium AI confidence, reflecting genuine uncertainty rather than a confident read.

notableStories.headline: PPP assails AJK Election Commission for 'facilitating rigging' in first phase of AJK polls
notableStories.context: One of several disputed claims in the week's central political storyline, the report presents the allegation without independent confirmation.

notableStories.headline: 9 cops martyred, 28 injured as police checkpost comes under attack in KP's Hangu
notableStories.context: The week's most severe single security incident, and a major contributor to this week's elevated social-negative share.

notableStories.headline: Two miners killed, several feared trapped after Quetta coal mine explosion
notableStories.context: A multi-day search and rescue story, it concluded on August 1 with the last two bodies recovered.

notableStories.headline: Naqvi says current system has 'collapsed', proposes administrative units to tackle challenges
notableStories.context: A governance-reform comment that drew responses from other officials into the following week, included here as context for readings still developing.
